summary: Frontend-only testing of the 模式编辑 (BetModeEditor) dialog opened via tool-mode in GameToolbar. All specified behaviors validated end-to-end on desktop viewport 1920x1200 with no console errors.

issues: '已投注' column is hardcoded to 0 for every row (mock-only, visual layer); acceptable per requirements but noted for future backend wiring.

critical_code_review_comments: action-allin and action-full both call selectAll() — semantically 梭哈 vs 全包 differ; consider distinct behavior when wiring backend.
toggle() uses `next[n] > 0` check — if amount is 0 (via manual input) checkbox will not uncheck cleanly; minor edge case.
invert() drops previous amounts and always sets 1; multiplier state is lost on invert — acceptable for visual mock.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mode editor fully verified: chip-大→14, action-full→28, mult-2→56, mult-10→280, invert(all)→0, bet-check-5 sets input to 1, input 5 + rowmult-5-2 → 10, mode-save fires toast '模式已保存', ESC closes dialog. No console errors.
